iceServers.description: Optional public STUN configuration passed to the browser's standard RTCIceServer interface. Omitted or empty means no ICE servers. Gathering starts only when a caller deliberately initiates a session. TURN and credentials are excluded.

items.description: The credential-free public STUN subset of the standard WebRTC RTCIceServer dictionary. URLs are discoverable configuration, never session credentials.

oneOf.description: Public, credential-free STUN URI using the RFC 7064 stun:host[:port] form. This version supports DNS names and IPv4 hosts, with ports 1 through 65535. IPv6 literals, secure STUN, TURN, paths, queries and fragments are not supported by this configuration subset.

items.title: RtcIceServer

supportedStreams.description: Discoverable media streams in SDP offer order. Directions describe the endpoint; the browser reverses SENDONLY and RECVONLY. Omitted means a legacy video SENDONLY stream.

items.description: A discoverable RTC media stream supported by an endpoint.

id.description: Stable identifier for the stream within the endpoint contract.

direction.description: Direction from the endpoint perspective; browser SENDONLY and RECVONLY are reversed.

codecs.description: Ordered permitted RTP codec MIME types, such as audio/opus or video/H264. Omitted uses browser defaults.

items.title: RtcSessionSupportedStream

dataChannels.description: Data channels the browser creates after media transceivers, using the standard RTCDataChannelInit options. Omitted means no data channels.

items.description: Standard WebRTC RTCDataChannelInit options plus the required label passed to createDataChannel. Channels are bidirectional.
items.title: RtcDataChannel

iceMode.description: Whether the endpoint expects a full offer up front or supports trickle ICE.

messageAuthorizationRequirements.description: Per-message authorization requirements for RTC session messages.

items.description: Authorization requirements for a specific RTC session message.
A typed authorization requirement for an RTC session message.
items.title: RtcSessionAuthorizationRequirement
RtcSessionMessageAuthorizationRequirement

description: RTC sessions initiate a connection using an offer and return an answer for the session. Follow disconnection events and close the session when the connection is no longer needed.
